[1/4] Remediate verified Entire audit findings in AIKit

impact_assessment.why: The recovered Entire audits report 8 defects in reforge, media, artwork, CLI and a drift test; each must be verified against the current tree and fixed where real.
impact_assessment.benefits: Restores ADR-297 completion semantics, makes every state write durable, bounds test process trees, removes dead code and duplicate writers, and turns the walker test into a real drift detector.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: settle_run and save_state behavior changes touch every Reforge entry point; dependency: process-tree teardown will reuse scripts.dogfood; concurrency: state writes keep the advisory lock; state: .aikit/reforge.json and generated knowledge files must stay consistent.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests per behavior change, full test budgets plus read-only gates, and an ADR recording the remediation.

[1/2] Audit the last three pushes and fix project media write regressions

impact_assessment.why: The last three pushes routed project media through the shared atomic writer, whose default shadow backup left .bak files in project and dossier trees, and the local media init --art branch still hard-coded force=True, bypassing the approved-logo guard.
impact_assessment.benefits: Re-seeding or applying media touches only named files, project hygiene stays green, and approved logos survive a plain re-run on both art paths.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the media CLI now honors --force exactly as documented; dependency: none added; concurrency: shared writer and lock unchanged; state: .aikit state keeps its .bak recovery shadow while project trees do not.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first regression tests for re-seed, apply and CLI flag forwarding; full Phase 4 gate triad plus dogfood; ADR-303 records the decision.

impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a unit regression for mixed bytes/text streams, run focused tests, then execute the full required gates before delivery.
